failure_policy: Hold on failed or uncertain visual evidence; no silent legacy fallback
inference_policy: Frozen flight preset and archived code; original grounded projection, Fill graph/settings and exact canonical opening timing
runtime_change: Release owned ComfyUI after each Fill pass before loading Qwen
upstream_scope: Fresh saved-setup photographs and native portrait; accepted control reused these inputs

validation.app_tests: 96 passing API/worker/driver tests with synthetic inference fixtures; isolated real archive imports and clone hashes verified
validation.ui_states: Canonical and enhancement state harnesses; JavaScript syntax
validation.local_qwen_replay: All nine checkpoints passed on saved Bamburgh control artifacts; initial failed prompt variants retained

limitations: Vision checks use sampled frames and can misidentify landmarks, timings or fine artifacts
Automatic layout is approximate creative geometry, not map reconstruction
Local frozen archives, Fill verification records and installed models remain deployment dependencies
Cross-location end-to-end reliability is not established by saved-artifact replay
